verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS work-management tool, but the evidence pack never documents a Trello export feature or any open export format. The only related items are a REST API token that can read the whole account, which is a developer building block rather than an export capability, and an 'Import data into Trello' feature, which runs in the opposite direction.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
